description.summary: the identifiers of a client's own toplevels

protocol.description:
ext-foreign-toplevel-list gives every toplevel an identifier which names exactly that toplevel across processes, and is never used again for another. Only the clients that list toplevels hear it. This protocol tells a client the identifier of a toplevel of its own, so that when the compositor names one of its windows to another process (Aizome's ❖Return names a terminal's window to the terminal command it starts), the client can tell which of its windows that is.
The identifier is the compositor's, not the client's: a client can't choose or change it, and it says nothing about what kind of window the toplevel is.

interface.name: aizome_toplevel_identity_manager_v1
interface.description: The global a client asks for its toplevels' identifiers with.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the manager. The identity objects made with it stay valid.

request.name: get_toplevel_identity
request.description: Make an identity object for one of the client's toplevels. Its identifier event comes when the toplevel is mapped, or at once if it is mapped already.

interface.name: aizome_toplevel_identity_v1
interface.description: The identifier of one toplevel, as ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 gives it to the clients that list toplevels.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the identity object. Its toplevel is unaffected.

event.name: identifier
event.description: The toplevel's identifier, sent each time the toplevel is mapped. It is valid while the toplevel stays mapped; once the toplevel is unmapped no other toplevel ever has it, and a toplevel mapped again is sent a new one.
